The first authenticated workflow step records monotonic start before pinned

The extra B materialization is a present source checkpoint choice, not proof it
is needed for controls or fits; ROOT must disposition it before launch.

Then six fixed Python consumer/authority/source controls, authored here, run.

from package status alone. Their exact names are in the copied test inventory.

The parser receives actual child stdout, never fabricated product events.
